title: HELIX Bridge: Ellucian Colleague → Enrollment
description: Maps Ellucian Colleague SIS registration data to the HELIX Enrollment resource.

source_files.description: Student academic credit. One record per student per course per term. Contains registration status, grades, credits.
Student course section enrollment. Links student to section. Contains grading and status info.
Course section definitions. Used for section reference resolution.

attribute_mappings.notes: STUDENT.ACAD.CRED.ID is a composite key: typically PERSON.ID*TERM*SECTION or a sequential system-assigned ID.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve to HELIX Student.helix_id via PERSON.ID lookup
Resolve to HELIX CourseSection.helix_id via section ID + term lookup
Resolve to HELIX AcademicPeriod.helix_id via term code lookup

Map Colleague academic credit status codes to HELIX. Common: 'N'→'registered' (new/registered), 'A'→'enrolled' (active/add), 'D'→'dropped', 'W'→'withdrawn', 'X'→'deleted/dropped'. If STC.VERIFIED.GRADE exists → 'completed'.
attribute_mappings.notes: Colleague status codes are institution-defined in the STUDENT.ACAD.CRED.STATUSES valcode table. The codes above are common defaults.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Convert Colleague date format to ISO 8601.
Convert to ISO 8601. Null if not dropped/withdrawn.
attribute_mappings.notes: Status dates are multi-valued, paralleling the multi-valued status field. Use the date associated with the drop/withdraw status entry.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Represents attempted credits for the section.
Direct map. Completed/earned credits. Null or zero if not yet completed.
Direct map. The verified (final, official) grade. Null if in progress.
attribute_mappings.notes: Colleague distinguishes 'verified' (official) from 'entered' (preliminary) grades. Always use verified.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Grade points (quality points) for the section.
Map Colleague grade scheme codes to HELIX. Typical: default letter grade scheme → 'standard', pass/fail scheme → 'pass_fail', audit → 'audit'. Scheme codes reference the GRADE.SCHEMES file.
attribute_mappings.notes: Colleague uses 'grade schemes' rather than 'grade modes'. The scheme defines which grades are valid and how they calculate GPA.
Repeat processing rules are institution-specific and configured in Colleague's repeat policy tables.
